		desc = "cm_trmm_legend_masonry"
		color = hsv360 { 26 70 25 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_legend_granted_best"
		color = rgb { 60 220 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_legend_granted_good"
		color = rgb { 255 255 255 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_legend_granted_poor"
		color = rgb { 230 60 50 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_legend_tied_multi"
		color = rgb { 0 220 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

# Per-right search variants of cm_best_town_right, hidden from the flyout
# (opened from the search panel and the urban right tooltips). The fill lerps
# from the low anchor to the right's own color by its fit score; stripes mark
# already-granted, best-or-tied-for-best-here, and other-right-granted
# locations. cm_trmm_tie_idx: 1-8 = two-way runner-up, 10 = 3+ tied.

cm_trmm_search_tooling = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_tooling <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_tooling_rights color: named color goods_tools, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4161
				max_color = hsv { 0.62 0.3 0.08 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_tooling }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 9
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = hsv { 0.62 0.3 0.08 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_TOOLING_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_tooling <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_TOOLING_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_TOOLING_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

		}
		else_if = {

cm_trmm_search_jewelry = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_jewelry <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_jewelry_rights color: named color goods_jewelry, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4159
				max_color = hsv { 0.085 0.95 1 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_jewelry }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 8
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 8
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_jewelry = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = hsv { 0.085 0.95 1 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_JEWELRY_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_jewelry <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_JEWELRY_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_JEWELRY_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0

cm_trmm_search_naval = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_naval <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_naval_rights color: named color goods_naval_supplies, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4126
				max_color = rgb { 0.11 0.17 0.4 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_naval }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 7
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 7
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_naval = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = rgb { 0.11 0.17 0.4 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_NAVAL_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_naval <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_NAVAL_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_NAVAL_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

cm_trmm_search_naval_refresh = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_naval <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_naval_rights color: named color goods_naval_supplies, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4126
				max_color = rgb { 0.11 0.17 0.4 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_naval }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 7
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 7
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_naval = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = rgb { 0.11 0.17 0.4 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_NAVAL_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_naval <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_NAVAL_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_NAVAL_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

cm_trmm_search_textile = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_textile <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_textile_rights color: named color goods_fine_cloth, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4184
				max_color = rgb { 183 169 155 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_textile }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 6
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 6
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_textile = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = rgb { 183 169 155 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_TEXTILE_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_textile <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_TEXTILE_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_TEXTILE_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0

		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_WEAPONRY_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_weaponry <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_WEAPONRY_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_WEAPONRY_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

cm_trmm_search_book = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_book <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_book_rights color: named color goods_paper, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4143
				max_color = rgb { 0.9 0.86 0.71 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_book }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 4
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 4
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_book = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = rgb { 0.9 0.86 0.71 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BOOK_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_book <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BOOK_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BOOK_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BREWING_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_brewing <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BREWING_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BREWING_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0

		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

cm_trmm_search_brewing_refresh = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_brewing <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_brewing_rights color: named color goods_liquor, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4157
				max_color = hsv { 0.9 0.8 0.2 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_brewing }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 2
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 2
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_brewing = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = hsv { 0.9 0.8 0.2 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BREWING_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_brewing <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BREWING_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_BREWING_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { Day }
}

cm_trmm_search_masonry = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_masonry <= 0 }
			value = rgb { 0 0 0 }
		}
		else = {
			lerp = {
				min_color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
				# royal_masonry_rights color: named color goods_masonry, main_menu/common/named_colors/02_map.txt:4191
				max_color = hsv360 { 26 70 25 }
				factor = { value = cm_trmm_right_masonry }
			}
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
			}
			value = rgb { 205 206 205 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
				OR = {
					var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 1
					var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 1
					AND = {
						var:cm_trmm_tie_idx = 10
						cm_trmm_tier_masonry = 0
					}
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 200 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				has_any_town_rights = yes
				OR = {
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
					has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 255 0 255 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_100"
		color = hsv360 { 26 70 25 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 0 0 0 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted"
		color = rgb { 205 206 205 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_best"
		color = rgb { 255 200 60 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "cm_trmm_search_legend_granted_other"
		color = rgb { 255 0 255 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_BEST_TOWN_RIGHT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx } }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_MASONRY_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cm_trmm_right_masonry <= 0 }
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_MASONRY_TT_NONE
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_CM_TRMM_SEARCH_MASONRY_TT_LAND
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = hidden
	allow_allocate_hotkey = no

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
